now.title: Fix arrow-function detection to exclude anonymous and include named arrows per spec
now.details: Update function detection logic so anonymous arrow functions are excluded by default (including top-level callbacks) while named arrow functions are included even when nested. Specifically, adjust name extraction to inspect parent declarators and update shouldProcessNode/DEFAULT_SCOPE handling to avoid flagging anonymous arrows and to require annotations for named arrows. Add or update unit tests in tests/ to cover top-level anonymous callbacks and nested named arrows to prevent regressions.
now.sourceItem: [functionality] Story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS: Anonymous arrow function callbacks are only excluded when nested or recognized as test callbacks; top-level anonymous callbacks (e.g., array.map(() => {})) remain in scope via DEFAULT_SCOPE/shouldProcessNode despite the requirement to exclude anonymous arrow functions by default.

next.details: Update relevant spec(s) in prompts/ to explicitly state how anonymous arrow functions are excluded by default and how named arrow functions are detected via parent declarators, matching intended behavior and tests.

next.title: Record decision on arrow-function naming resolution
next.details: Create or update a MADR in docs/decisions/ documenting the decision to treat named arrow functions as requiring annotations even when nested and to resolve names via parent declarators; include rationale and consequences.
next.sourceItem: [functionality] Story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS: Named arrow functions nested inside other functions can be treated as effectively anonymous because name extraction does not inspect parent declarators, so they may be excluded even though named arrow functions should require annotations.

next.details: Add targeted tests for shouldProcessNode/DEFAULT_SCOPE covering top-level anonymous callbacks (array methods), nested anonymous callbacks, and named arrows assigned to variables or properties to ensure correct inclusion/exclusion behavior.
next.sourceItem: [functionality] Story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS (REQ-FUNCTION-DETECTION#1): Nested named arrow functions may be treated as effectively anonymous because name extraction ignores parent declarators, so they can be excluded from annotation requirements.
